title: TCDD-AhR: AhR-dependent heterochromatin opening in vascular smooth muscle initiates a bifurcated myeloid-stromal cascade (analysis release)
description: Code, 172 derived result tables, 23 figures and the 21-claim audit matrix (Supplementary Table 1) for a study of 8- and 16-week TCDD exposure in ApoE-null mice with smooth-muscle-specific Ahr deletion, profiled by single-cell ATAC and RNA sequencing. Raw sequencing data are not included; see data/DATA_AVAILABILITY.md for accessions (GSE276870, GSE276872, GSE131778, GSE276152, GSE205502).
